scope: Clearance and grip experiments after bilateral little-loop release. Initial Opening A is independently placed; no completed Cup, boat or Star is certified.

grip_stop.json.phase: Slide the right index surface to open clearance around the old thumb loop
grip_stop.json.scope: First rejected 30 Hz sample, not a substep contact event. Failed state is retained for diagnosis.

unexecuted_2mm_proposal.reason: Joint limits prevent target clearance with retained near contact; never integrated.

friction_comparison.scope: Abrupt parameter change at a moving checkpoint; not a trial initialized with higher friction.

control.scope:
Time common-wrist reversals from measured free-loop turning points or crossings.

This experimental controller reuses continue_cup's exact-state continuation and
collision guards. It observes privileged simulated rope state and commands only
robot joints. An elevated free band is a timing candidate, not a successful Cup.
Optional near-strand checks stop integration at the first rejected output
frame; they are not substep contact feedback.
control.timing_velocity: Three-frame finite difference of fixed-material relative positions

loop_throw_motion.json.scope:
Plot fixed free-loop material relative to the original thumb bridge.

The X/Z projection is a motion diagnostic, not a crossing or topology test.
Use it together with contact tracking, physical audits and the rendered motion.

accepted_swing_motion.json.scope: Fixed material X/Z projection over the near-grip prefix. Little-finger clearance fails; not an accepted free-loop throw.

loop_release_audit.json.scope: Necessary release diagnostics only; not a threading or figure certificate. Excludes swept collisions, robot self-collisions, rope-radius clearance at robot-body meshes and material identity. Central-body boxes and complete-edge arm/body hull checks are conservative: overlap does not by itself prove penetration of the original mesh.
loop_release_audit.json.initialization: Independent placement, not replay of Position 1 or source dynamics

dynamic_near_grip_audit.json.scope:
Check near-strand proximity and accidental old-loop pairing during motion.

This checks each recorded frame, without requiring a stationary hold. Contact
fractions and edges may change. It is not a force, topology, collision or
original-support certificate; run those separate diagnostics as well.

little_recontact.scope: Rope-edge capsule diagnostic; excludes knuckle mesh contacts.
